inventory.what: _engine_cache (one engine, one IRIS connection per server process) and _engine_lock = threading.RLock(); _engine() holds the lock for the whole block
_run_cypher: _engine_lock around execute_cypher and the retry after _reset_engine (rows materialised inside)
/admin/load (async) waits for the lock in the thread pool (run_in_threadpool)
Bolt: one engine (one IRIS connection) per session, created lazily by _make_engine, used only on the event-loop thread; no lock
sample API: one engine and connection on app.state, no lock; /health is a plain def (thread pool), /api/cypher and the GraphQL resolvers are async (event loop)
no IRIS LOCK; each write is one engine call whose lock plan belongs to the engine module (03, 08, 11)
